resources.string: I-SandFly 0.3.0 inezakhi ezintsha emakhasini alandelayo. Ukuze uzifunde futhi kamuva, vula okuthi Izakhi ezintsha ku-SandFly phezulu kumasethingi e-SandFly.

Ngekhibhodi ebonakalayo, khetha imephu yokhiye ye-SandFly, ye-VoiceOver, ye-NVDA, ye-JAWS noma ye-Orca ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi, Khetha ukhiye wemephu, kanye nokhiye we-SandFly eyisebenzisayo. Kumamephu okhiye e-NVDA, e-JAWS ne-Orca, okhiye bemicibisholo ne-Tab bayahambisa ngaphandle kokhiye we-SandFly, futhi kukhona ukuzulazula ngezinto, ikhesa yokubuyekeza nokuthi Qaphela umbhalo esikrinini. Isinqamuleli semodi yokubhrawuza singashintshwa, kuhlanganise nokucindezela ukhiye we-SandFly kabili.

Amaphrofayili okunyakaza, ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, anika ukunyakaza eminye imiyalo, futhi okuthi Iphrofayili yokunyakaza elandelayo kushintsha phakathi kwawo. Okuthi Ukunyakaza kuma-app nokuthi Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi kuma-app kunika ukunyakaza nokhiye eminye imiyalo kuma-app akhethiwe. Ukuswayipha ngakunye ngomunwe owodwa kunakho nokuswayipha bese ubambe: swayipha, gcina umunwe ungahambi, bese uwuphakamisa.

Isichazamazwi sokukhuluma, ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Inkulumo, sisho umbhalo okhethiwe ngendlela ehlukile kuyo yonke inkulumo. Okuthi Vumela ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zikhulume kuvumela ama-app, nekhibhodi yamanje, ukuthi akhulume nge-SandFly. Umlando webhodi yokunamathisela ugcina lokho okukopishayo, futhi nge-Shizuku nalokho okukopisha kwamanye ama-app.

Okuthi Thayipha igama le-app nge-Braille ukuze uyivule kungumyalo owenza isikrini sibe yikhibhodi ye-Braille yesiqalo segama le-app. IsiJapanese siwulimi olusha lwe-Braille. Ikhibhodi ye-Braille iyafihlwa uma kuxhunywe ikhibhodi ebonakalayo.

Okuthi Thumela umyalezo, Vula noma vala ukukhuliswa, Buyisela emuva, Phambili ngokushesha nokuthi Izinqamuleli zokufinyelela kungabelwa ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Imiyalo. Okuthi Sebenzisa i-SandFly njengesithombe sangemuva, ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Isibonisi, kugcina i-SandFly isebenza kumafoni lapho isilondolozi sebhethri siyimisa. Okuthi Setha kabusha umsindo wokufinyelela ngemva kwamakholi, ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukukhipha umsindo, kususa inkulumo ku-earpiece ngemva kwekholi.

Iziskripthi manje zingathinta isikrini, zicindezele okhiye, ziqalise imiyalo ye-SandFly, zivule amawindi, ziqaphele umbhalo, futhi zikhulume phakathi namakholi. Ngaphambi kokufaka iskripthi, i-SandFly ibonisa ukuthi sivelaphi nokuthi i-SandFly isisayinile yini.

I-SandFly Pro iqaphela izinkinobho, umbhalo nezinye izakhi ezidwetshwa ama-app nemidlalo ngaphandle kokuzidalula, futhi izibonise njengezinto ongaswayiphela kuzo futhi uzithephe kabili. Khetha okuthi Qaphela isikrini kumenyu ye-SandFly, noma vula ukuqaphela isikrini kwe-app kumenyu ye-SandFly noma ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, SandFly Pro, Ukuqaphela isikrini okuzenzakalelayo.
